introduction.title: Full Stack Developer & Data Analyst
introduction.description: Passionate about computing since I was 14, I started by exploring cybersecurity before moving into development. Today, I specialize in Full Stack Development and Data Analysis. I am very thorough in my learning and I place great importance on open source, privacy and data confidentiality.

specializations.title: Full Stack Development
specializations.description: Design and development of complete web applications with modern technologies such as React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, while integrating DevOps practices to ensure continuous delivery and efficient management.

specializations.title: Data Analysis
specializations.description: Working with large datasets and building analysis models with Python and R, using libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn to extract key insights and improve decision-making.

specializations.title: UI/UX Design
specializations.description: Creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces, using tools like Figma, to deliver a smooth and enjoyable experience on every platform.
